who.value: seller who has just listed an item

job.value: confirm the listing is live and consider turning on delivery

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Successfully listed!' with the item thumbnail and confetti says the listing is live.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Manage listings' is the solid teal button, but the screen's nudge goal (delivery) sits lower in a plain card 'Listings with delivery sell faster. Try it now!'.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Manage listings' predicts its result, but the delivery and 'Set up Buyer Magnet' cards are chevron rows that don't say whether they open settings or explain more.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Delivery copy is plain, but 'Buyer Magnet' and 'SPX' appear without explanation for a casual seller.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks for no decision beyond optional next steps the seller can judge right after listing.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Both nudges are collapsed into tappable cards, but the delivery card spells out three lines of detail ('from S$1.80', 'No labels needed with SPX', 'Doorstep pickup or drop-off point') up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Celebration, manage listings and post-listing nudges all belong right after listing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The success header acts at a glance, but each nudge card carries two to three sentences of body text.
